Convert to a ggplot2 object

Source: R/build.R, R/grid.R
as_ggplot.Rd

as_ggplot() renders a kggplot() specification into a regular ggplot object, which you can then customise with any ggplot2 function or save with ggplot2::ggsave(). Printing a kggplot does this implicitly.

Usage

as_ggplot(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'ggplot'
as_ggplot(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'kggplot'
as_ggplot(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'kgg_grid'
as_ggplot(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A kggplot (or a ggplot, returned unchanged).

...

Unused.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

p <- kggplot(iris, "Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width", color = "Species")
g <- as_ggplot(p)
class(g)
#> [1] "ggplot2::ggplot" "ggplot"          "ggplot2::gg"     "S7_object"      
#> [5] "gg"
